passage:
A company made a mirror that showed weather, news, and health information while people brushed their teeth.
At first, Alex thought it was amazing. Then he noticed he began every morning with headlines before fully waking up.
Some days, the news made him anxious before school. He changed the settings so the mirror showed only time and weather in the morning.
The mirror was still smart, but Alex became smarter about using it.
Information is useful, but timing matters. A device that can show everything should not always show everything. People need quiet spaces before the world enters.
